parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (val_bpb 1.104599) as it performed significantly worse than our current best (1.061423). Reverting to DEPTH=6 and commit 2d763e6. I suspect the recent instability may be due to the interaction between learning rate and batch size. I will now focus on reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to stabilize training.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit 2d763e6 and decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to improve stability and potentially achieve better convergence within the 5-minute budget.
